{{Icon of Sin}}
The '''Icon of Sin''' (aka [[wikipedia:Baphomet|Baphomet]] and Gatekeeper or Demonspitter) is a monster which first appears in ''[[Doom II]]''. It appears two more times in ''[[Final Doom]]'', and a similar creature is found in ''[[Doom II RPG]]'', which appears in two forms [[VIOS]] (Virtual Icon of Sin), and a physical Icon of Doom (that spawned the VIOS virus). It makes yet another appearance in ''[[Doom (2016)|DOOM]]'' where it is given a backstory. Its latest appearance is in ''[[Doom Eternal]]'', where its full form is seen.
